releases.name: Monster Girl Montage Puzzle
releases.summary: This puzzle is beyond everything! It captures, fascinates, and annoys at the same time. Are you able to beat chaos and overcome inevitability of contingency? Can you pacify the endless struggle of elements and win this battle?You have to fill in the playing field with the cards of the same element. It is not so easy to do as all the four elements are permanently struggling. Water floods ground. Air evaporates water and destroys ground. Fire burns air, while water and ground extinguish fire. Remember these rules. They will help you to solve the puzzle.Struggle of elements would last endlessly if it had not been for the fifth element – magic crystal. Joining together with any of the four elements the crystal boosts it and super exalts it over the rest. You will get the magic crystals as bonuses; also you will have an opportunity to buy them.Two play modes are available. “Mission” play consists of 37 battles; each of them is more complicated than the previous one. “Arcade” play gives an opportunity to battle endlessly on a small (3 × 3) or large (4 × 4) playing field.

releases.name: Spin & Drip! Wet Guy Puzzle
releases.summary: And they're off! Experience the thrill and excitement of a day at the races. Try to win a virtual fortune without the danger of losing real money. An authentic recreation of the classic mechanical horse race betting machine found in arcades and casinos around the world. Place your bets on any of the five horses before they run automatically. Win up to 25 credits from just one bet if you dare to risk it or play safe with the favorites. Features simulated horse racing including acceleration and overtaking just like the arcade game plus with retro sound effects. You start off with 10 credits. Just place your bets using the glowing "BET NOW" buttons. You can bet while the "BET NOW" Sign appears from the top. Once the button lights turn off and the Bet Now sign disappears then betting is over and racing begins. If you lose all your credits, do not worry. Just leave the machine and grab some more free virtual credits from the change machine. You only get 10 credits at a time so the aim is to try to build it up slowly unless you like to take a risk.You do have the option to purchase 1000 credits but it is not necessary and does not affect the games enjoyment or performance.

releases.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted
releases.summary:
Hardcore yet cute Danmaku shooting makes a grand comeback!

    Muchi Muchi Pork! – Ride rogue machines and turn all of humanity into pigs!
    PinkSweets: Ibara Sorekara – Sisters charge into battle to rescue their mother imprisoned on a remote island.

Two of the most unique titles in CAVE’s legendary shoot-’em-up lineup are back.

Master Various Versions and Game Modes Across Both Titles

    Muchi Muchi Pork! – Rogue machines run wild on Earth! Turn humans into pigs one after another! Blast through enemies and use the massive “Lard Attack” to rack up a mountain of score items!
        Included Variations and Game Modes
            Version 1.0 – The original version that debuted in arcades.
            Version 1.01 – A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
            Arrange Mode – Trigger “Fever Mode” with Lard Attacks! Fill the entire screen with score items.
            MANPUKU Mode – A high-difficulty mode featuring “Revenge Fire” (suicide bullets).
            HARAHARA Mode – Start the game directly from the increased difficulty of the 2nd Loop.
    PinkSweets: Ibara Sorekara – Rescue Mom from a forced marriage! The five sisters launch a massive assault on the wedding venue. Block enemy fire with your Shield, then unleash the “Rose Cracker” after charging to wipe out both enemies and bullets!
        Included Variations and Game Modes
            Version 1.0 – The original version that debuted in arcades.
            Version 1.01 – A balanced mode with buffed player ships for a more accessible experience.
            Arrange Mode – The new “Hadou Cannon” weapon accelerates the score attack to new heights.
            HARDER Mode – A high-difficulty mode where destroyed enemies release massive amounts of Revenge Fire.
            EXTENDED Mode – An ultra-hard mode with increased 1st Loop difficulty and access to the 2nd Loop.
            S-ATTACK Mode – A score attack mode where you play Stage 6 with infinite lives and a strict time limit.

All-New Arrangements! “Boosted” with Rich Options

Featuring a completely new arranged background music soundtrack. Switch between the original and arranged tracks to create your own custom setlist!

Featured composers include Daisuke Matsumoto, Yosuke Yasui, Hagane, Sean Bialo.

Also supports Online Rankings and Replay Data recording, allowing you to save and share your best.
